artworks.title: The Death of Caesar
artworks.description: Gérôme’s Walters canvas freezes the Ides: Caesar fallen, conspirators exiting the Curia. Academic history painting is the modern image of the dictator Ovid will soon lift to a comet — murder as the hinge before apotheosis.

films.title: Julius Caesar
films.description: Mankiewicz’s Shakespeare film (Brando as Antony) keeps Caesar’s assassination and funeral as mid-century screen classics of the Roman dictator.

films.title: Cleopatra
films.description: Rex Harrison’s Caesar opposite Taylor’s Cleopatra — Hollywood’s grandest staging of the dictator’s Egyptian years before the knives of the Senate.

popCulture.title: Metamorphoses XV (apotheosis of Caesar)
popCulture.creator: Ovid
popCulture.description: Ovid’s poem — our atlas hinge — turns the murdered dictator into a star: Venus snatches Caesar’s soul to heaven as a comet, proof metamorphosis still happens in Augustan Rome.

popCulture.title: Julius Caesar
popCulture.creator: William Shakespeare
popCulture.description: Shakespeare’s tragedy makes Caesar’s death and Antony’s funeral the English stage’s lasting dossier of ambition, friendship, and the Ides.
